name: daypart-codes
title: AcmeTV daypart codes
description: Vendor namespace example. AcmeTV labels its pricing options with its own daypart grid. Informational: a buyer without this extension loses nothing it needs to transact.

extends.semantics: Display labels for the dayparts the option covers.

changelog.change: Current version: daypart codes with a minimal spec, one conformance storyboard, and the reference code, all pinned by the digest. Uses the kernel container ExtensionEntry with `data`, and the host properties `extensions` and `extensions_state`. The spec and manifest text follow the documentation style guide; the rules and their IDs are unchanged.
